Search developer unlocked hint: Developer page unlocked. It is highly recommended not to use it because it is mostly useless.
Old navigation description: In development. Keep disabled unless you are testing it.
Sidebar size description: Drag slider to choose the size of the sidebar.
Sidebar collapse menu title: Full to icon only collapse button
Sidebar collapse menu description: Adds a button for the the sidebar to switch between full and icon-only size.
Sidebar content list description: Remove items you do not want from the sidebar.
Sidebar content empty hint: Open a Roblox page with the left navigation visible to detect sidebar items.
Always show close description: Forces Roblox's sidebar close/menu button to always be visible.
Friend styling description: Restyles the friends carousel with a dark glass card and animated presence ring glow.
Hide age badge description: Hides new age rate badge, it is SELECT and KIDS sign near Roblox logo at the left top side.
Search ban enable description: Blocks Roblox discover searches for keywords you add below.
Search ban description: When a banned word is searched on Discover, results are hidden and an error screen is shown instead.
Search ban empty hint: No banned words yet. Add words above to block them from Discover search.
Settings sync description: Copy, export, or import RoPrime settings as JSON file. You can edit the JSON in the preview.
Settings sync import failed: Couldn't import this file. Choose a valid settings export file.
Settings sync reset done: All settings were reset to defaults.
Info card body: This extension adds useful design-focused features.
Developer section description: This page is hidden by default. It is highly recommended not to use it because it is mostly useless.
Custom CSS description: CSS you write here injects into every Roblox page while RoPrime is enabled.
Enable cosmetics description: Enable to see profile effect previews and equip options.
